posts.text:
Thursday, Nov 19: Toronto's streetcars lost 952 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 510 Spadina southbound. A typical 4.9 km trip lost 13 min (usually 11).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch westbound, 13 min over 8.0 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Thursday's slowest spot: Southbound on York St, approaching Adelaide St West.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 6 s here (usually 1 min 43 s). Across 144 trips, that adds up to 5.0 hours.
This signal has no transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of York St around Adelaide St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch at Adelaide St West is highlighted, peaking at about 2 min 6 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: York St southbound, approaching Adelaide St West
shot.sub: Thursday, Nov 19: 2 min 6 s lost per streetcar · 144 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Thursday, Nov 19: 510 Spadina. 1 in 15 trips (30) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side (southbound, 13), instead of going on to Union Station.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 510 Spadina route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side, gives how many southbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Union Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Thursday, Nov 19: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

35% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 297 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 35% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Thursday, Nov 19: at the busiest moment (5:40 pm), 148 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 98% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,022 hours on streetcar routes.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Thursday, Nov 19, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 148 streetcars at 5:40 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 98% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Thursday, Nov 19: Spadina Ave at Queens Quay West North Side (510 Spadina northbound).

Riders waited 10.0 min on average, against 4.9 if cars had come as scheduled: 5.1 min extra. 18% of cars came bunched, and 25 of 128 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Spadina Ave at Queens Quay West North Side in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 5.1 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
